title: Dash will not connect after updating phone to android 16
symptom: After updating phone to Android 16, the Omnipod Dash pod will not initialize or connect. Multiple pods failed to initialize or communicate after cannula insertion, and the user cannot successfully start a new pod.
cause: The thread indicates that pairing (BT bonding) must not be used with Android 16, and the user had imported preferences that may have enabled bonding.
fix: The maintainer states that pairing must not be used with Android 16 and provides a link to Bluetooth troubleshooting documentation. The user should ensure BT bonding is disabled.
evidence_quote: pairing must not be used with android 16
